title: ayenia oblongifolia
intro: Ayenia oblongifolia, commonly known as Mexican holly or wild jasmine, is a plant species native to Mexico and parts of Central America. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its various health benefits, including the treatment of fever, respiratory issues, and digestive problems. The therapeutic actions of Ayenia oblongifolia include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which help to reduce pain and inflammation, fight off infections, and protect against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
